answer: Staked curation blocks bulk fake identities: each candidate needs a curator who locks money behind it. The curator stakes 100 credits at the oasis registry. A disputed identity goes to a curator summit, where three curators re-check its record. A false endorsement burns 50 credits, and the bond stays frozen like a glacier until a clean verdict releases it, so the k-th fake still needs a fresh 100-credit stake, and 1,000 fakes need 100,000 credits. Endorsement rental fails when the summit overturns it, costing the rented curator the bond. An honest curator pays 100 once.
